result.title: Cooking up a catering business with ChatGPT
result.description:
Running a restaurant is a 24/7 commitment. And apparently finding catering clients is just as time-consuming. Nick Baumann visited Richard at @thedumplingprince in Toronto to put ChatGPT to work on a catering deck and automated outreach. It didn't get an apron.

result.title: How Oracle Uses Codex to Help Business Users Get Answers
result.description:
Richard Lam, Group Vice President at Oracle Applications Lab, shares how his team uses Codex to help business users get answers from company data. By describing the outcome they want, users can get an analysis, a report, or an application, with Codex gathering the information from internal systems.

Read the full Oracle story: https://openai.com/index/oracle/

result.title: Block on Finding and Fixing Security Risks with OpenAI
result.description:
“Now you know and now you can take action before someone else knows.”

A weakness in your code can be part of a much bigger attack. Seeing how those weaknesses connect gives defenders a clearer picture of where to act.

Block’s Chief Information Security Officer, James Nettesheim, shares how OpenAI’s cyber capabilities can help uncover software vulnerabilities and connect them into a path to compromise.

Then comes the work that turns discovery into action: identify the affected software and its owner, propose a patch, and verify that the fix works, with a person guiding deployment.

Watch James on what AI can make possible for cybersecurity teams—from vulnerability analysis and hidden security risks to patch verification and the next steps defenders can take.
